label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to u, then to URL constructor at sink line 29. The !isNonPublicAddress(a) check only blocks loopback/site-local/link-local/any-local addresses, allowing attackers to specify arbitrary public hostnames that pass validation and reach the openStream() sink. Resolved sink value: new java.net.URL(u).openStream() where u = param = user input.

evidence.note: User param flows to u, DNS resolves parsed.getHost(), then openStream() called on original u - allows SSRF to public hosts
